summary: Implemented a reusable WhatsApp preview/confirmation dialog and refactored WhatsApp link construction into shared payload builders, integrating the preview flow for single-student (Attendance row) and bulk “Message All” (Attendance + Student List). One notable gap is that the single-recipient preview displays a normalized phone number rather than the phone number “as stored.”

missing_requirements.requirement: Preview UI for a single student must display the parent phone number as stored (not normalized/rewritten).
missing_requirements.reason: The preview dialog displays `payload.targetNumber`, which is derived from `normalizePhoneNumber(phoneNumber)` and then formatted with `+...`, rather than showing the original stored `student.parentMobile` value.

hallucinated_features.description: Bulk WhatsApp payload builder appends a hardcoded “Parent contacts” list (with Hindi/English header) containing every student name and parentMobile into the message body.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-6 requires previewing the exact final bulk message as passed into the wa.me URL, but does not itself request changing/adding new appended content. The diff introduces a specific appended contacts block inside the shared bulk builder, which may be an unrequested behavioral change if this was not already the app’s existing bulk-link behavior.
